description: 🐍 A fast-paced 3D snake game built with Three.js — WebGL graphics, 3 difficulty levels, mobile joystick support, persistent high scores. Play free in browser.
readme:
# 🐍 Serpentine — 3D Snake Game A fast-paced 3D snake game built with Three.js and vanilla JavaScript. No frameworks, no installs — runs entirely in the browser. 🎮 **[Play Now → serpentine-game.netlify.app](https://serpentine-game.netlify.app)** ![GitHub deployments](https://img.shields.io/github/deployments/S-SUJAN-S/serpentine-game/github-pages?label=GitHub%20Pages&style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20with-HTML5%20%2B%20Three.js-orange?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square) --- ## 🎮 Play Online | Platform | Link | |----------|------| | 🟢 Netlify | [serpentine-game.netlify.app](https://serpentine-game.netlify.app) | | 🟢 GitHub Pages | [s-sujan-s.github.io/serpentine-game](https://s-sujan-s.github.io/serpentine-game) | --- ## ✨ Features - 🎯 3 difficulty levels — Easy, Medium, Hard - 🏆 Persistent high scores per difficulty - 📱 Mobile support — Joystick, Swipe and Mouse controls - ✨ WebGL 3D graphics with particle effects - 🎖️ Achievement system with milestone toasts - 📊 Score history and session stats - ⚡ Zero dependencies — pure HTML + JS --- ## 🕹️ Controls | Input | Action | |-------|--------| | Mouse | Guide snake | | WASD / Arrow Keys | Keyboard control | | Space | Pause / Resume | | R | Restart | | T | Toggle walls | | M | Switch control mode | | ESC | Settings | | ` (backtick) | Debug overlay | --- ## 🛠️ Tech Stack | Technology | Purpose | |------------|---------| | [Three.js r128](https://threejs.org/) | 3D WebGL rendering | | Vanilla JavaScript ES6+ | Game logic | | HTML5 + CSS3 | Structure & styling | | localStorage | Persistent high scores | --- ## 🚀 Run Locally Just open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server needed. ```bash git clone https://github.com/S-SUJAN-S/serpentine-game.git cd serpentine-game # Open index.html in your browser ``` --- ## 📁 Project Structure ``` serpentine-game/ └── index.html # Entire game — single file ``` --- ## 🤝 Contributing Pull requests are welcome! Feel free to open an issue for bugs or suggestions. --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the MIT License — see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ---

Made with ❤️ using Three.js by S-SUJAN-S
